description: Breaking changes allowed through scripts/compat.ts, each with its reason and the release it breaks against. An entry applies only while compat compares with that release; an entry that matches no change fails as stale.

exceptions.reason: SuperPipeline's StageDef was written from boards made from its templates and web app, which number every stage. SuperPipeline has never required `order`: board create (POST /v1/boards, apps/api/src/routes/boards/collection.ts) needs only a string `key`, and the whole-pipeline write (setStages in apps/api/src/board/pipeline.ts) needs `key` and `name`; both store stages as sent, sorted by `order`, where a stage without one keeps its place. So a board whose stages were sent without `order` has always been read back without it, and SuperDispatch, validating board-read v0.0.20 strictly, refused such a production board at #/stages/0 on every pass. `order` is made optional, and no more: `key` and `name` stay required and `order`, when present, is still a number. A reader that validated v0.0.20's shape strictly was already refusing these real bodies. Recorded in the charter: decisions/2026-11-24-a-contract-wrong-about-what-ships-is-fixed-in-place.md (charter#47).
